reply_text:
I found four Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent Pree the list in our DM. Only PD-5302 is labelled as Fieldworks in the source. The other three are my best reading of how the sources describe the account.

| Ticket | Where it comes from | How sure |
|---|---|---|
| PD-5302 | #central-random, Hollis, Oct 14: "one more ticket number for Marrow Fieldworks… a follow-up from this week" | Named as Fieldworks |
| #8841 | #central-random, Tobias, Oct 13: Door 2 on the west yard double-books when flatbeds check in early | Inferred: he files it under "Tobias's dealer account" |
| #4409 | Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026): a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at Salina North | Inferred: listed as "Pree's dealer account" |
| #4412 | The same Moss digest: a glitch in the driver SMS prompt when staging combine trailers | Inferred: same as #4409 |

- **Why the three are inferred:** Moss's digest lists #4409 and #4412 under "Pree's dealer account", directly below the line saying Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. I took the dealer account to be Fieldworks, and Tobias as its owner after that handoff. Neither source says so outright, so I asked Pree to check #8841 with Tobias.
- **Left out:** FR-882 and PD-4821 are Marrow Agrisupply tickets, a different account.
- **Checked:** I only read things Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and public files. There were no other Fieldworks tickets from this week. The workspace knowledge base was running on keyword search only, so a note that never uses the word "Fieldworks" could still have been missed.
